description: Stable machine-readable error codes for the StellPoker coordinator API. Single source of truth: the backend embeds this file for error responses, the OpenAPI specs reference the code enum, and the frontend maps each code to an i18n message.

errors.description: The request was malformed or failed validation.
Authentication is required or the supplied credentials are invalid.
The request signature could not be verified.
The authenticated principal is not permitted to perform this action.
The requested resource does not exist.
The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.
The authentication nonce has already been used.
An MPC committee node became unavailable during proof generation; start a fresh session.
Too many requests; retry after a short delay.
The MPC committee or Soroban RPC could not be reached.
The coordinator is temporarily unable to serve the request.
Soroban RPC / contract is not configured on this deployment.
The coordinator is in maintenance mode.
The coordinator is draining for a blue-green cutover; retry against the incoming instance.
